question: Kusukuntla Prabhakar Reddy, became Member of Legislative Assembly from ______ constituency in Telangana, in November 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Munugode.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Kusukuntla Prabhakar Reddy** (born 1965) is an Indian politician and the current member of the legislative assembly representing Munugode (Assembly constituency).
 
• He belongs to Bharat Rashtra Samithi.
 
• He was the TRS Party contestant for the Munugode By-Elections 2022, arising due to the resignation of sitting MLA Komatireddy Rajagopal Reddy from the office.
